user_decision: Date of birth 点击显示年月日选择器，选择后自动回填
approved_deltas: Replace manual text entry with a keyboard-accessible field of the same 56px height / 18px radius / 18px padding / YYYY-MM-DD placeholder. Do not change existing page wording or layout.

Use existing EventConfirmDialog through a dedicated DateOfBirthPickerConfirmDialog and uni-app picker-view with Year/Month/Day columns, Done and Cancel. Theme-only colors, rpx dimensions, existing controlled bottom-sheet transition and measured bottom safe area.

Selection only updates the unsaved DOB draft on Done; Cancel/escape/mask/hide does not change it or storage. Continue retains existing exact 18-year validation and 500ms custom Loading before Store persistence.
No text keyboard. Calendar clamps month lengths/leap days and prevents dates after the Store UTC day; under-18 dates remain selectable for the existing rejection flow.

Years 0000 through the current UTC year preserve the full existing four-digit Store date domain; no new maximum-age restriction. Preview an 18-year-old date for an empty/invalid draft, without silently filling it.

data.persistence: unchanged Store metadata, written only by save_registration_age after Continue
data.picker_indices: transient UI calendar indices; not business data
